formal_findings_added.witness: Different-material GT boosters A/B on a compatible axis within depth; B powered externally/already powered, A not directly powered. Old identity gate rejects B; native neighbor-signal branch accepts B.
formal_findings_added.boundary: Source/bytecode decision witness, not a measured redstone world or arbitrary network simulation.

positive_scope: Detector powered polling at 20 ticks and weak 15 / direct UP 15 paths exist in both selected modern native implementations.
Command minecart priority and ordinary container comparator routes exist; native mod-cart comparator extension is not reported as a missing feature.
Registry contains three rail families for ten materials, using plain BlockItems. Current material-first order differs from old family-first order; no UI sorting bug inferred solely from this.
NeoToolBindings.isTool intentionally delegates the interaction-tool predicate while craftKind uses GTToolHelper.isTool before its GTToolItem cast; no cast defect inferred from the facade name.
